user_direction: Do not use Davis. Ranking disagreement is the phase1 result; correctness is phase2.
primary_question: How strongly do publicly available DTI systems agree in their drug-for-target and target-for-drug rankings on fixed candidate matrices?

matrix.primary: 720 project molecules x96 metadata-selected target sequences =69120 requests
matrix.sensitivity: Full720x384=276480 parent catalogue; per-query comparison always on identical candidates.
matrix.selection: Seed20260921; round-robin functional families, SHA256 ordering, prefer distinct known homology clusters. No model scores, experimental labels, SPR384 selection or runtime success used.
matrix.scope_limit: Independent research question, project-derived data. The96-target subset inherits parent catalogue bias, is intentionally family-balanced and is not a random sample of the full proteome.
matrix.no_fda_reaudit: Use project drug catalogue terminology; not a new claim that every entry is currently FDA-approved.

phase1_analyses: Per-query Spearman and Kendall tau-b, reported separately in both directions.
Tie-aware Top5/10/20 overlap and random-set references with candidate counts.
All-current-model common coverage primary view and pairwise common coverage sensitivity; expose denominators and missingness.
Rank association by target family and input/truncation status; descriptive association, not architectural causality.
Direction asymmetry, broad versus near-family rankings and model relationship clusters where matched coverage supports them.
Nested candidate-pool sensitivity; distinguish normal TopK competition from changes in pair scores or pairwise order.
phase1_query_gate: At least20 jointly scored candidates, irrespective of labels. Report excluded queries and constant-score undefined correlations.
native_score_contract: Use prespecified native head/direction; do not compare raw units or call all models Kd regressors.
ties: Average ranks; Kendall tau-b; fractional membership at TopK boundary; constant-score ties do not establish meaningful concordance.
random_reference: For two independent untied K-subsets from the sameN candidates, expected overlap is K^2/N. Shuffle scores/ranks within queries for correlation nulls when testing, with dependence-aware query uncertainty.
interpretation: Low rank agreement is a descriptive finding, not proof either model is wrong.
High rank agreement does not prove experimental correctness.
Pairwise subsets with different denominators do not define a transitive performance ranking.

For pairwise independent deterministic scorers, enlarging the candidate set can change ranks and TopK while preserving the relative order of shared candidates; do not mislabel this as model instability.
phase2_deferred: Checkpoint-specific supervised exposure audit for generalization claims
historical_preparation: Initial Davis/measured-label preparation retained under phase2_not_active for provenance; not read by active phase1 builder or analysis.
